requirement: Competency records are verified before deployment
Emergency drills are completed and documented
Operator and laboratory environments are separated
Class II BSC certification is valid
Class III glovebox integrity is verified
Triple packaging is available and compliant
Internal and external controls are defined
Nonconformities and corrective actions are tracked
Temperature monitoring and alarms are functional
Disinfectant selection and concentration are validated
Contact times are specified in SOPs
Access control is restricted and logged
Visitor access is controlled and escorted
Evacuation routes are marked and unobstructed
Critical consumable levels meet mission demand
Vehicle and specimen transport conditions are verified
Route and security contingencies are planned
UPS and generator capacity are tested
Donning and doffing competency is observed
Assays are verified for intended specimen types
Current SOPs are available at point of use
Service support is available during deployment
Fatigue and shift duration are managed
Two-person verification is used for critical tasks
Weather and terrain risks are assessed
Post-mission review and lessons learned are scheduled
